# configuration file /etc/pw-vars/nginx.conf:
# Hand-written: targets built from map and set variables, an unresolvable variable,
# a Unix-socket proxy_pass, proxy_pass under if and limit_except, a named location.
pid /run/pw-vars.pid;

events {}

http {
	map $http_host $backend {
		hostnames;
		default 127.0.0.1:8000;
		app2.example.com 127.0.0.1:8002;
		include /etc/pw-vars/map-extra.conf;
	}

	map $uri $pool {
		default blue;
		~^/green green;
	}

	upstream blue {
		server 127.0.0.1:8100;
	}

	upstream green {
		server 127.0.0.1:8200;
	}

	resolver 127.0.0.53;

	server {
		listen 8080;
		server_name "~^(?<sub>.+)\.example\.com$" example.com;
		set $legacy "127.0.0.1:8300";

		location / {
			proxy_pass http://$backend;
		}

		location /pool {
			proxy_pass http://$pool;
		}

		location /legacy {
			proxy_pass http://$legacy;
		}

		location /dyn {
			proxy_pass http://$host$request_uri;
		}

		location /sock {
			proxy_pass http://unix:/run/sock/app.sock:/;
		}

		location /cond {
			if ($request_method = POST) {
				proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8400;
			}
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8401;
		}

		location /except {
			limit_except GET {
				proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8500;
			}
			root /var/www/except;
		}

		# Variables in the URI part: the host still resolves.
		location /uri {
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8700$request_uri;
		}

		location ~ ^/re/(.*)$ {
			proxy_pass http://blue/$1;
		}

		location /args {
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8701$uri$is_args$args;
		}

		location /scheme {
			proxy_pass $scheme://green;
		}

		location /secret {
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8702/?token=abc; # nginx refuses userinfo
		}

		location /redirect {
			return 302 https://example.com/?token=abc;
		}

		location @fallback {
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8600;
		}
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/pw-vars/map-extra.conf:
app3.example.com 127.0.0.1:8003;
